name: Disakisperma
look_here_first: GREEN SPRANGLETOP / DISAKISPERMA DUBIUM: often a robust perennial with several nearly fingerlike one-sided racemes, spikelets carrying 4–13 florets. For best confirmation look for SPECIAL hidden cleistogamous flowerheads in lower leaf sheaths, a short ciliate membranous ligule, and a mature lemma apex often slightly notched. Older name Leptochloa dubia—same taxon.

quick_split: Dinebra panicea subsp. mucronata is generally annual with smaller 2–4-flowered spikelets along numerous finer branches; Disakisperma typically perennial with more florets and can make hidden axillary/low sheath flowering heads. Some Diplachne resemble it; use a technical key and glume/lemma under 20x.
